contract.generation_scope: Only failed shotIds enter image/video generation.
contract.preserved_scope: Preserved asset ids are resolved through the authenticated account/project asset boundary before any provider stage.
contract.composition_scope: The complete current storyboard orders preserved and regenerated videos into a new timeline with a new audio asset.
contract.render_scope: Composition creates a new revision-bound render; the source render asset and bytes remain unchanged.

fail_closed: stale project, story or storyboard binding
preserved video associated with another shot
duplicate or unrelated timed source asset
